name: Paper tear
description: A transition out of a full-frame page. The page rips in two down a jagged line with a white torn fibre edge, the halves twist and fall away to the sides, and the shot is under them.
when: Right after a full-frame page (Press front, Banknote, a cover or a card), to get back to the shot.
needs: a still of the page at the frame size (cover.png)
